segments.text: Where does meaning actually come from? Frankl says there are only three doors. Only three.
Door one, a deed. Something you make, finish, or put into the world. He kept his life's work rolled in his coat to have one.
Door two, love. You can be stripped of everything you own and still find a reason to live in a single person.
Door three, your attitude. Change the situation when you can. When you can't, you still choose how you meet it. Pick a door today.
That's Man's Search for Meaning. Honest verdict on the channel.
